verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs offer copy-paste checkout/payment-link/Elements integrations, sandbox testing with test cards, idempotency, webhooks, and API keys, and community testimony confirms fast integration ('up and running and accepting recurring payments in less than an hour', clear documentation) despite some unrelated support gripes. missing for 10: explicit multi-language SDK code-sample evidence in the pack (only generic doc references, not shown per-language snippets) and a broader/more recent independent corroboration beyond one old HN thread.
